title: Enter’s model-list proxy returns models
summary:
Enter’s model-list proxy was fixed, while the text catalog shed unused entries and Mistral Nemo aliases.

Fixed Enter’s `/api/generate/openai/models` proxy to request the upstream model-list endpoint instead of its root, which returned a redirect. The same PR added browser-protection headers and updated asset and HTML caching on the main site.

Removed `mistral-naughty` from the available model list and service registry, along with its `mistral-romance`, `mistral-nemo-instruct-2407-romance`, and `mistral-roblox` aliases.

Removed unused text services and orphaned model IDs, leaving the registry aligned with 18 available services. Model descriptions and OpenAI o4 Mini’s capitalization also got a cleanup.
